import math

svg = []
svg.append('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="100%" height="100%">')
svg.append('  <!-- Design System: MIRA SKETCH -->')
svg.append('  <rect x="0" y="0" width="200" height="200" fill="#ffffff" />')

# Cyan Marker Shadows
svg.append('  <g stroke="#82e0d8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.5" stroke-width="16">')
# Box shadow
svg.append('    <path d="M 60,140 L 100,160 L 140,140" />')
# Wave shadow
svg.append('    <path d="M 70,100 C 60,70 90,40 120,60" />')
svg.append('  </g>')

# Main Sketch Group
svg.append('  <g stroke="#1a1a1a" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">')

# Thick Lines (4.5)
svg.append('    <g stroke-width="4.5">')
# The Magic Box (Caixa Preta)
box_lines = [
    # Top opening (flaps)
    "M 60,100 L 100,115 L 140,100 L 100,85 Z",
    # Open flaps
    "M 60,100 L 40,70 L 80,60",
    "M 140,100 L 160,70 L 120,60",
    # Front walls
    "M 60,100 L 60,140 L 100,160 L 100,115",
    "M 100,160 L 140,140 L 140,100"
]
for path in box_lines:
    svg.append(f'      <path d="{path}" fill="#ffffff" />')

# The Wave coming out of the box
wave = "M 80,105 C 60,90 60,60 80,45 C 95,35 125,45 130,65 C 135,80 120,95 100,90 C 85,85 85,75 95,70 C 105,65 110,75 105,80"
svg.append(f'      <path d="{wave}" />')

# Sparkles/Stars
svg.append('      <path d="M 50,30 L 50,40 M 45,35 L 55,35" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 140,30 L 145,45 M 135,37 L 152,37" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 160,90 L 160,100 M 155,95 L 165,95" />')

# Messy wires (Tangled code)
svg.append('      <path d="M 70,145 C 50,160 80,180 60,190 C 50,195 40,180 50,170 C 60,160 80,165 75,185" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 120,150 C 140,170 110,180 130,190 C 145,195 150,175 140,165 C 130,155 110,165 125,180" />')
svg.append('    </g>')

# Sketch Lines (2.0) - Double strokes for hand-drawn feel
svg.append('    <g stroke-width="2.0">')
box_sketch = [
    "M 58,102 L 98,117 L 142,102 L 102,87 Z",
    "M 58,102 L 38,72 L 78,62",
    "M 142,102 L 162,72 L 118,62",
    "M 58,102 L 58,142 L 98,162 L 98,117",
    "M 98,162 L 138,142 L 138,102"
]
for path in box_sketch:
    svg.append(f'      <path d="{path}" />')

wave_sketch = "M 78,107 C 58,92 58,62 78,47 C 93,37 123,47 128,67 C 133,82 118,97 98,92 C 83,87 83,77 93,72"
svg.append(f'      <path d="{wave_sketch}" />')

# Add some < > brackets floating in the wave
svg.append('      <path d="M 85,55 L 75,60 L 85,65" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 115,55 L 125,60 L 115,65" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 105,50 L 95,70" />')

# Sparkles secondary
svg.append('      <path d="M 48,32 L 52,38 M 47,33 L 53,37" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 142,32 L 143,43 M 137,39 L 150,35" />')
svg.append('    </g>')

# Details (3.0)
svg.append('    <g stroke-width="3.0">')
# Question mark on the front of the box (caixa preta)
svg.append('      <path d="M 75,125 C 75,115 85,115 85,125 C 85,130 80,132 80,137" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 80,143 L 80,144" stroke-width="4.5" />') # dot
# Exclamation mark
svg.append('      <path d="M 120,120 L 120,135" />')
svg.append('      <path d="M 120,142 L 120,143" stroke-width="4.5" />')
svg.append('    </g>')

svg.append('  </g>')
svg.append('</svg>')

with open(r'd:\repos\DevComIA\samples\vibe_coding.svg', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(svg))
